snippet.title: Stark Penitentiary Official Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the FIRST version of the Trailer. This is showcasing what I've been working on when no one was able to see. I want to finish the Intro of the game before I upload the next Build Update and the longer updated version of the Trailer. This is the SHORT version as I'm planning to make a longer one in the coming weeks.

Follow my Twitch (Streams): AlexThomas125
Follow my Instagram (Story Updates and Old Posts): @DaAlexThomas125
Join my Discord (Updates and Community): https://discord.gg/8JTKKkj
Like and Subscribe, I have likes and dislikes purposefully not showing on my channel, but it still helps!
